- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:478-481 | severity=medium | confidence=4

  WHY: The reviewer warned that older consumers with the legacy ledger path may not match this new layout, so bookkeeping commits could be misclassified.

  WHY: The reviewers said this blocks auto-merge on transient metadata issues; one review treated it as a problem, while another explicitly classified it as an intentional safety tradeoff, so the severity/disagreement is recorded at the higher end.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:146-150 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: An unreadable commit subject causes the script to fail-open early with `ADVANCE=unknown`.
  WHY: The reviewers agreed this can stop checking the rest of the commit range and let the caller proceed on potentially stale base information.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:124 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The GitHub API response handling can still fail on malformed non-JSON content.
  WHY: Both reviewers noted that checking only for empty output is insufficient if a proxy or intermediary returns invalid JSON.
- .ai/review_issue_ledger/pr-1521.txt | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-PR ledger file is tracked in the repository as a runtime workspace artifact.
  WHY: The reviewer said this violates the per-PR isolation design and should be gitignored rather than committed.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:474 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The step name says “template mode” even though the install runs whenever the renderer script exists.
  WHY: The reviewer called this misleading operationally, but it is only a logging/name clarity issue.
